title: Project Neuroeco: Emotion and LLM Economic Decisions

s1.description: The question: does a counterpart’s emotion change an LLM’s economic decisions?

s2.description: What we read: human neuroeconomics of emotion, fairness and trust, and LLMs as economic agents.

s3.description: Design: four game roles at fixed payoffs, five message conditions, three models, pre-registered follow-ups.

s4.description: Findings: recognition without action, anger lowers trust, sadness was the life event, Mistral’s generosity.

s5.description: Extensions and deeper analyses: size, comprehension, quantisation, valuation curves, wording, human ratings.
